rule: Business-day orders ship in 1-2 business days from warehouse confirmation
spoken_summary: Spedizione standard in uno o due giorni lavorativi dopo la conferma magazzino

rule: Express option when available on the order: usually next business day after warehouse confirmation
spoken_summary: Express se presente sull'ordine: di solito il giorno lavorativo successivo

rule: Free standard shipping from 49 euro cart subtotal before discounts
spoken_summary: Spedizione standard gratuita da quarantanove euro di carrello

rule: Default carrier for Italy is BRT or GLS as shown on the Shopify fulfillment; never invent another carrier
spoken_summary: Corriere quello indicato da Shopify sulla fulfillment

rule: Tracking email goes out when the parcel is marked fulfilled in Shopify
spoken_summary: Email di tracking alla fulfillment Shopify

rule: 14 calendar days from delivery date for unused items in original packaging
spoken_summary: Reso entro quattordici giorni dalla consegna se articolo non usato

rule: Customer pays return shipping unless the item is defective or wrong; staff confirms exception
spoken_summary: Costo reso a carico del cliente salvo difetto o articolo sbagliato

rule: Open return request via support; staff sends RMA label instructions by email
spoken_summary: Reso: staff invia istruzioni RMA via email

rule: Exchanges only for size or colour when stock exists; otherwise refund path via staff
spoken_summary: Cambio solo taglia o colore se c'è stock; altrimenti rimborso via staff

rule: Unfulfilled orders can be cancelled by staff the same business day if not yet picked
spoken_summary: Annullamento possibile prima del picking via staff

rule: Fulfilled or shipped orders cannot be cancelled; use return flow
spoken_summary: Dopo la spedizione non si annulla; si usa il reso
